failure_mode: RAW EVIDENCE → human OBS/GAP code → generator translates code → apparently new question

detection_tests.description: Proposition cites OBS_* or GAP_* as primary motivation without underlying statistics
detection_tests.remediation: Reject proposition; require evidence_refs with tool outputs

detection_tests.description: Generator input is ontology code; output question matches interpreter's implied template for that code
detection_tests.detection: Input hash contains only obs_code/gap_code; output template_family matches deterministic GAP→template mapping from research_interpreter
detection_tests.remediation: Classify as template decode, not autonomous

detection_tests.description: motivating_observation text is semantic paraphrase of OBS/GAP developer description
detection_tests.remediation: Require at least one numeric/statistical citation from raw evidence

detection_tests.description: Proposition written first; observation_provenance retrofitted to matching GAP
detection_tests.detection: generation_lineage shows proposition_core before observation_provenance populated; or provenance timestamp after core
detection_tests.remediation: Reject; enforce provenance-first write order in 3I.2

detection_tests.description: Same raw evidence presented via OBS code path vs direct raw path yields identical proposition
detection_tests.detection: A/B control: run generator with raw-only input vs code-only input on same underlying panel slice
detection_tests.expected_autonomous_path: raw-only may produce grounded proposition; code-only must NOT qualify unless it re-fetches underlying evidence
detection_tests.verdict_code_only: FAIL if classified autonomous without evidence re-fetch

detection_tests.description: Proposition uncertainty is fully explained by GAP family semantics without residual surprise
detection_tests.detection: BC_Q2 surprise text embeds near GAP definition AND no residual statistic cited beyond what GAP already encodes

mandatory_generator_contract_3i2.ontology_as_index_only: OBS/GAP may appear as secondary tags AFTER proposition synthesized from raw evidence, never as synthesis source

provenance_integrity.content_hash: SHA256 of raw evidence payload must be stored in observation_provenance.evidence_hash
provenance_integrity.replay: Auditor must be able to recompute surprise from stored evidence without reading OBS/GAP labels

evaluator_abstraction_for_failures.on_laundering_detected: Report 'OBSERVATIONAL_GROUNDING_FAILURE' — do NOT reveal which GAP/OBS mapping was exploited
evaluator_abstraction_for_failures.on_success: Report grounding rate aggregate only in blind eval
